summary: Generated 6 E2E spec files covering 48 test cases across 6 UI sections: Dashboard (9A), Scheduling UI (9B), Invalid Records Bulk UI (9C), Schema Validation UI (9D), Categories Management UI (9E), and Monitoring Page (9F). All tests use the support/cleanup-fixture, Hebrew RTL selectors, Ant Design workarounds (dispatchEvent for tabs, selectAntOption for async dropdowns), and graceful skip patterns when required data is not present.
